cases.description: Login API rejects a missing email
cases.preconditions: Application is running and no authenticated session is required.
steps: POST /api/auth/login with a password and no email.
cases.expectedResult: HTTP 400 with a required-credentials error; no session is created.
cases.actualResult: Passed: observed behavior matched the expected result.

cases.description: Login API rejects a missing password
cases.preconditions: Application is running and no authenticated session is required.
steps: POST /api/auth/login with an email and no password.
cases.expectedResult: HTTP 400 with a required-credentials error; no session is created.
cases.actualResult: Passed: observed behavior matched the expected result.

cases.preconditions: A disabled tenant fixture exists in the configured test database.
steps: POST /api/auth/login with the disabled tenant's valid credentials.
cases.expectedResult: HTTP 403 explains the account is deactivated; no authenticated session is issued.
cases.actualResult: Passed: observed behavior matched the expected result.

cases.description: Unpaid owner login requires activation payment
cases.preconditions: An active owner fixture with Pending payment status exists.
steps: POST /api/auth/login with the pending owner's valid credentials.
cases.expectedResult: HTTP 402 identifies the required activation payment and does not issue a session.
cases.actualResult: Passed: observed behavior matched the expected result.

cases.description: Paid owner login creates a persistent owner session
cases.preconditions: A paid owner fixture exists in the configured test database.
steps: Sign in with the paid fixture account.
Verify the owner dashboard redirect and /api/auth/me session.
Reload the dashboard and verify the remembered session.
cases.expectedResult: The owner reaches /owner/dashboard and remains authenticated after reload.
cases.actualResult: Passed: observed behavior matched the expected result.

cases.description: Registration API rejects missing required fields
cases.preconditions: Application is running; no database fixture is required.
steps: POST /api/auth/register with an empty JSON object.
cases.expectedResult: HTTP 400 lists the required registration fields.
cases.actualResult: Passed: observed behavior matched the expected result.

cases.description: Registration form rejects an invalid email format
steps: Open /register.
Enter a name, invalid email, and a password of at least six characters.
Check native form validity before submitting.
cases.expectedResult: The email input reports a type mismatch and the form cannot submit.
cases.actualResult: Passed: observed behavior matched the expected result.

cases.description: Registration rejects an existing paid owner email
cases.preconditions: A paid owner fixture exists in the configured test database.
steps: POST /api/auth/register using the existing paid owner's email.
cases.expectedResult: HTTP 409 informs the user to sign in; no second account or checkout is created.
cases.actualResult: Passed: observed behavior matched the expected result.

cases.description: Registration rejects passwords shorter than six characters
cases.preconditions: Application is running; validation occurs before database access.
steps: POST /api/auth/register with valid name/email and a five-character password.
cases.expectedResult: HTTP 400 explains that passwords must contain at least six characters.
cases.actualResult: Passed: observed behavior matched the expected result.

cases.description: Owner can access owner dashboard and owner API but not tenant dashboard
cases.preconditions: A paid owner fixture exists in the configured test database.
steps: Sign in as the fixture owner.
Request GET /api/owner/tenants and check its response.
Open /tenant/dashboard directly.
cases.expectedResult: Owner API returns HTTP 200 and a direct tenant URL redirects to /owner/dashboard.
cases.actualResult: Passed: observed behavior matched the expected result.

cases.description: Tenant can access tenant dashboard and tenant API but not owner dashboard
cases.preconditions: A valid tenant test account is configured using TENANT_EMAIL and TENANT_PASSWORD.
steps: Sign in as the configured tenant.
Request GET /api/tenant/rent-summary.
Open /owner/dashboard directly.
cases.expectedResult: Tenant API returns HTTP 200 and a direct owner URL redirects to /tenant/dashboard.
cases.actualResult: Passed: observed behavior matched the expected result.

cases.description: Admin-only owner API is forbidden to owner and tenant sessions
cases.preconditions: Admin, owner, and tenant credentials are available.
steps: Sign in separately as owner and tenant.
Request GET /api/admin/owner with each session.
cases.actualResult: Passed: observed behavior matched the expected result.

cases.description: Super Admin can access the admin-only owner API
cases.preconditions: Valid Super Admin credentials are configured.
steps: Sign in as Super Admin and request GET /api/admin/owner.
cases.expectedResult: The admin-only API responds with HTTP 200 and a successful response body.
cases.actualResult: Passed: observed behavior matched the expected result.

cases.preconditions: Application is running and browser cookies are cleared.
steps: Request owner, tenant, and admin APIs without an authentication cookie.
cases.expectedResult: Each protected API responds with HTTP 401 or 403.
cases.actualResult: Passed: observed behavior matched the expected result.

cases.description: Each role is restricted to its own dashboard by middleware
cases.preconditions: Application is running and JWT_SECRET matches the application configuration.
steps: For Admin, Owner, and Tenant, open each of /admin/dashboard, /owner/dashboard, and /tenant/dashboard.
Verify the user's own dashboard is permitted and all other dashboards redirect to their role dashboard.
cases.expectedResult: All nine role/route combinations enforce role-specific access.
cases.actualResult: Passed: observed behavior matched the expected result.

cases.description: Role-restricted APIs deny requests from other authenticated roles
cases.preconditions: Application is running and JWT_SECRET matches the application configuration.
steps: Use Admin and Tenant sessions to request GET /api/owner/tenants.
Use Admin and Owner sessions to request GET /api/tenant/rent-summary.
Use Owner and Tenant sessions to request GET /api/admin/owner.
cases.actualResult: Passed: observed behavior matched the expected result.

cases.description: Expired sessions are rejected and protected routes redirect to login
cases.preconditions: Application is running and JWT_SECRET matches the application configuration.
steps: Set an expired rentora_token cookie.
Request /api/auth/me.
Open /admin/dashboard directly.
cases.expectedResult: The session API returns no user and middleware redirects to login.
cases.actualResult: Passed: observed behavior matched the expected result.

cases.description: Logout clears the session and remembered authentication state
cases.preconditions: A paid owner fixture exists in the configured test database.
steps: Sign in as the fixture owner.
Click Logout.
Request /api/auth/me and inspect local storage.
cases.expectedResult: The user is redirected to login, server session is null, and remembered user data is removed.
cases.actualResult: Passed: observed behavior matched the expected result.
